author: VivekGRamaswamy
text:
How will we fix the property tax crisis? What’s the plan to prosecute Medicaid fraud? What are we going to do about data centers? Sanctuary cities? Photo ID to vote?

Voters deserve a debate. Acton needs to stop hiding & show up.
